description: This PHP source file defines the AuthProviderDao class, which provides data access methods for managing OpenID authentication providers, their details, and user identities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes CRUD operations, search with filtering, and pagination functionality.

classes.name: AuthProviderDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling operations related to OpenID authentication providers, their details, and user identities.

methods.name: getAuthProviderById
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenIdProvider entity by its ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Fetches details of an auth provider given its provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns a list of auth providers filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersPaginator
methods.description: Handles pagination and filtering logic for searching auth providers.

methods.name: getAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Counts the number of auth providers matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteProviders
methods.description: Deletes (disables) a list of auth providers by their IDs.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Persists a new or existing OpenIdProvider entity.

methods.name: saveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Persists extra details for an auth provider.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Retrieves active open ID providers for login display.
